long_biography.plain_text:
Used machinery became Randal ‘Randy’ Ringhaver’s defining operating contribution to Ring Power, the Florida Caterpillar dealership he led for decades. After seeing independent brokers profit from trade-ins, he built an internal business that repaired, marketed and sold equipment across national and international markets.

Ringhaver also served Flagler College as a trustee from 1989 to 2022, including five years as board chairman. His donations supported employee-family scholarships, historic preservation, business education and a student centre. He now serves as a trustee emeritus, while the Ringhaver Student Center remains a campus hub for classrooms, student services and clubs.
